name: erp-monorepo
description: Unified runner for ERP Backend, Frontend, and Standalone Micro-Apps

scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,SUPERADMIN,NURSING,HOMECARE,VISITOR,UNCF,HR,INVENTORY,FINANCE,CRM" -c "magenta,blue,red,cyan,green,yellow,white,dim,brightMagenta,brightBlue,brightGreen" "npm run --prefix Backend dev" "npm run --prefix Frontend dev" "npm run --prefix superadminapp dev" "npm run --prefix NursingApp dev" "npm run --prefix HomeCareApp dev" "npm run --prefix VisitorApp dev" "npm run --prefix UNCFDonationsApp dev" "npm run --prefix HRApp dev" "npm run --prefix InventoryApp dev" "npm run --prefix FinanceBillingApp dev" "npm run --prefix CRMApp dev"
scripts.start:core: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue" "npm run --prefix Backend dev" "npm run --prefix Frontend dev"
